test_title: PYST 16: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Identify the idiom/phrase that can best substitute the underlined segment.**

I'm going to be __in trouble__ if I don't submit my homework to the teacher.
solution:
The correct answer is **"up the creek."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Up the creek"** is an idiom that means being in a difficult or troublesome situation. ("Up the creek" एक मुहावरा है जिसका अर्थ है कठिन या परेशान करने वाली स्थिति में होना।)

 
 
• **Example:** *If any more people quit, we'll really be **up the creek**__.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the speaker is expressing their worry about the consequences of not submitting their homework, which can be considered a difficult situation.
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **"A devil's advocate" **is used when someone is arguing against an idea to test its strength. (वाद-विवाद, परिचर्चा आदि में विषय का गहराई में अध्ययन करने के उद्देश्य से भिन्न विचार व्यक्त करनेवाला व्यक्ति जिसपर वह स्वयं भी व्यक्तिगत रूप से विश्‍वास नहीं करता है; छिद्रान्वेषी)
 
• **"Off base"** can be used to describe someone who is not following the rules or is not in sync with others. (कोई व्यक्ति जो नियमों का पालन नहीं कर रहा है या दूसरों के साथ तालमेल नहीं बिठा रहा है)
 
• **"The lion's share" **is used to describe the majority of something. (किसी चीज़ के बहुमत का वर्णन करने के लिए किया जाता है)

43:Tace,

The correct answer is Option 4, **"A decree had already been passed by the ruler of the community against that decision."**
